Our Story

Born from a Passion for Travel

HillsophiaTrip was founded in 2020 in Parbhani, Maharashtra, by a team of travel enthusiasts who believed that everyone deserves to experience the world — without the stress of planning it alone.

Over the past 4 years, we've helped over 1,200 travelers explore the snow-capped valleys of Kashmir, the golden sands of Goa, the serene backwaters of Kerala, and the glittering skyline of Dubai.

We operate on the belief that travel should be accessible, safe, and deeply meaningful. Every package we design is a reflection of that philosophy.

Est. 2020
Parbhani, MH
1200+ Travelers
50+ Destinations
Our Purpose

Mission & Vision

Our Mission

To make travel accessible and memorable for every Indian family by offering affordable, safe, and well-planned tour packages with exceptional personal service — from Parbhani to the world.

Our Vision

To become Maharashtra's most trusted travel brand — known for transforming ordinary trips into extraordinary memories while maintaining the highest standards of safety, comfort, and customer satisfaction.

What We Offer

Complete Travel Solutions

From planning to the last mile — we handle it all

Domestic Tours

Explore the incredible diversity of India with our handcrafted domestic tour packages. From snow-laden peaks of Kashmir to tropical beaches of Goa, our itineraries cover India's most iconic destinations.

  • Kashmir, Goa, Manali, Kerala, Rajasthan & more
  • Comfortable AC buses and private cars
  • Verified hotels and resorts
  • Professional local guides at each destination
  • Group and private tour options
Book This Tour

International Tours

Step beyond borders and experience the world with HillsophiaTrip's international packages. We handle everything — from visas to accommodation — so you can focus on making memories.

  • Dubai, Bali, Thailand, Singapore & more
  • Visa guidance and documentation support
  • International flight coordination
  • Currency exchange assistance
  • Travel insurance guidance
Book This Tour

Group Tours

Planning a trip with colleagues, friends, or a large family? Our group packages are designed for 10 to 100+ travelers, ensuring everyone has a seamless, enjoyable experience.

  • Corporate outings and team trips
  • College and school excursions
  • Exclusive group discounts
  • Dedicated group coordinator
  • Customizable itineraries for groups
Book This Tour

Trekking Tours

For the adventure seeker in you — our trekking packages take you through spectacular Himalayan trails with experienced, certified mountain guides ensuring your safety every step of the way.

  • Kashmir Great Lakes, Manali-Leh trek & more
  • Certified mountain guides
  • Complete safety gear provided
  • Camping equipment included
  • Beginner, intermediate & expert routes
